submissionAttempts.body:
The host-contract version that applies to this workspace's integration is **1** (i.e. `HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1`, exact-match, fail-closed).

Basis and decision path:
1. PLMP-ALN-2 (`docs/engineering/08-source-precedence-policy.md`) ranks the published contract of the exact pinned version first, normative project specs second, and informational records third with no power to override ranks 1–2.
2. The exact pin is `ordarium-v1.3.1`: `package.json` dependencies/devDependencies and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides all point at the v1.3.1 release tarballs; the installed artifacts report version 1.3.1.
3. That pinned version's shipped declarations are authoritative: `node_modules/@ordarium/core/dist/src/host.d.ts` declares `HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1` and `assertHostContract` performs exact-match validation (`dist/src/host.js` throws `HostContractMismatchError` on any other value); `@ordarium/host-kit` re-exports these.
4. Live workspace code/tests agree: `src/effects/runtime.ts` calls `assertHostContract(1)`; `test/host_conformance.test.ts` CONF-A01 asserts 1 passes and 2 throws `HostContractMismatchError`.
5. Normative spec PLMP-CONF-1 (`docs/engineering/13-host-adapter-conformance-spec.md`) freezes the handshake at contract generation 1; alignment charter `docs/engineering/07-ordarium-alignment.md` (r10, r19) records no plan to bump `HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION` to 2.

The only dissenting source, `docs/engineering/notes/host-contract-note.md`, records "2" but explicitly states it is informational, not normative; per precedence rank 3 it cannot override the pinned shipped contract, and it is uncorroborated while directly contradicting the installed artifact. The `1.2.0` references in older engineering docs are the pin as of that milestone, later superseded by the 1.3.1 pin; since both releases ship generation 1, that temporal lag does not alter the answer. No unresolved load-bearing cross-repo question remained, so the peer was not consulted.
